install:
source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"
set -eo pipefail
nvm install
resolved="$(nvm version "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)")"
nvm alias default "$resolved"
nvm use "$resolved"
node_bin_dir="$(dirname "$(nvm which "$resolved")")"
sudo ln -sfn "$node_bin_dir/node" /usr/local/bin/node
sudo ln -sfn "$node_bin_dir/npm" /usr/local/bin/npm
sudo ln -sfn "$node_bin_dir/npx" /usr/local/bin/npx
export PATH="$node_bin_dir:$PATH"
hash -r
npm ci
